title: Migrate a Postgres database to Lakebase (Beta)
body: You can now copy an existing PostgreSQL database into a Lakebase project in a single, one-time migration. Lakebase assesses the source database for compatibility, then copies its roles, schema, and data to a branch that you choose. Migrations are available in the Lakebase App and through the Postgres API and SDKs, with no separate enablement step. See [Migrate a Postgres database to Lakebase](/aws/en/oltp/projects/migrations) for migration steps and region availability.
